title: A qualitative study exploring poultry farmers’ barriers and motivations to seasonal human influenza vaccine uptake as a preventive public health measure because of avian influenza
abstract: Abstract Background: The global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) has increased concerns about reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and the potential emergence of novel pandemic influenza strains. Annual seasonal influenza vaccination can reduce this risk and is recommended by the Dutch government and the World Health Organization (WHO) for risk groups, including poultry farmers. This study explored Dutch poultry farmers’ perceptions regarding this vaccination and identified motivations and barriers influencing their willingness to be vaccinated. Methods: This qualitative study involved semistructured interviews with twelve poultry farmers in the Netherlands. Interviews were conducted online via Microsoft Teams between June and October 2024. The interview guide was based on the attitude‒social influence‒self-efficacy (ASE) model. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed using thematic analysis. Results: Attitudes towards vaccination differed both generally and regarding seasonal influenza vaccination due to avian influenza risk. Approximately half considered vaccination a reasonable preventive measure. The main motivation for vaccination was preventing reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and thereby reducing the risk of a future pandemic. Participants also viewed vaccination as a sign of societal responsibility and a way to contribute positively to the public image of the poultry sector. Important barriers included diminished trust in the government, perceived regulatory burden within the poultry sector, and perceived limited benefits of vaccination. Participants emphasized that vaccination should remain voluntary. Participants generally perceived their personal risk of avian influenza infection as low, while acknowledging potentially severe consequences for public health if a novel influenza virus were to emerge. Trusted sources of information included veterinarians, general practitioners, poultry advisers, and agricultural organizations. Accessibility was considered essential: local, flexible in timing, and free of charge. Conclusions: Acceptance of seasonal influenza vaccination among poultry farmers is influenced by a combination of societal responsibility, perceived risk, trust in the government, and practical considerations. Vaccination strategies should emphasize the societal benefits of vaccination and the potentially serious public health consequences of the emergence of a novel influenza virus. Improving vaccine uptake among poultry farmers requires engagement of trusted intermediaries and vaccination programs that are accessible and tailored to farmers’ practical needs.

analysis.study_design_and_population: This qualitative study involved semistructured interviews with twelve poultry farmers in the Netherlands, conducted online via Microsoft Teams between June and October 2024.
analysis.methods: The study used semistructured interviews guided by the attitude‒social influence‒self-efficacy (ASE) model, which were transcribed verbatim and analyzed using thematic analysis.
analysis.main_results: Attitudes towards vaccination varied, with approximately half of the participants considering it a reasonable preventive measure. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that vaccination acceptance among poultry farmers is influenced by a combination of societal responsibility, perceived risk, trust in the government, and practical considerations, offering a novel insight into the factors affecting vaccine uptake in this specific group.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform public health strategies by emphasizing the need for vaccination programs that highlight societal benefits and the potential public health consequences of novel influenza virus emergence, while also addressing practical barriers to uptake.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and reliance on self-reported data, which may introduce bias. However, the evidence is strong given the detailed thematic analysis and the inclusion of multiple perspectives from poultry farmers.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the perceptions of Dutch poultry farmers regarding seasonal human influenza vaccination as a preventive measure against avian influenza. The research highlights the importance of societal responsibility, perceived risk, and practical considerations in influencing vaccine uptake. The findings suggest that vaccination strategies should emphasize the public health benefits and address barriers such as lack of trust in government and perceived limited benefits. The study, based on semistructured interviews with twelve farmers, provides a nuanced understanding of motivations and challenges related to vaccine acceptance. While the small sample size and self-reported data limit the generalizability of the results, the thematic analysis offers a robust interpretation of the factors affecting vaccine uptake in this group. The results have implications for public health by informing the development of more effective vaccination programs tailored to the needs of poultry farmers.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨家禽养殖户对季节性人流感 疫苗接种 作为禽流感预防措施的看法,强调对禽流感病毒和人流感病毒之间的重配以及新出现的大流行毒株风险的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项定性研究涉及对荷兰 12 名家禽养殖户的半结构化访谈,并于 2024 年 6 月至 10 月期间通过 Microsoft Teams 在线进行。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用以态度社会影响自我效能(ASE)模型为指导的半结构化访谈,逐字记录并使用主题分析进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 人们对 疫苗接种 的态度各不相同,大约一半的参与者认为这是一种合理的预防措施。主要动机是防止禽流感病毒和人流感病毒之间的重配,而重要的障碍包括对政府的信任度降低、监管负担以及 疫苗接种 的有限益处。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,家禽养殖户对 疫苗接种 的接受度受到社会责任、感知风险、对政府的信任和实际考虑等综合因素的影响,为影响该特定群体对 疫苗 吸收的因素提供了新颖的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过强调 疫苗接种 计划的必要性来为公共卫生战略提供信息,这些计划强调新型流感病毒出现的社会效益和潜在的公共卫生后果,同时也解决了吸收的实际障碍。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和依赖自我报告数据的限制,这可能会引入偏差。然而,鉴于详细的主题分析和家禽养殖户的多种观点,证据是强有力的。

title: InfluProto: Predicting Cross-Species Transmission of Influenza A Virus via Prototype Learning
abstract: Zoonotic influenza A viruses pose constitute a significant persistent threat to global public health, yet quantitative approaches for assessing their cross-species transmission potential remain limited. Here, we present InfluProto, a deep learning model that introduces prototype learning into host prediction for influenza A virus, framing conceptualizing host adaptation as a continuous process rather than a discrete outcome. InfluProto embeds viral sequences into a continuous representation space anchored by human, swine, and avian prototypes, using cosine distances as a quantitative measure of host adaptation. InfluProto accurately discriminated among the three host classes, achieving recall and precision exceeding 0.97, and substantially outperformed conventional classification models models—particularly on challenging zoonotic strains, including the 2009 pandemic H1N1 (pdm09) lineage. Beyond host classification, the learned representations captured biologically meaningful host-adaptive signatures,; notably, with pdm09 viruses occupying occupied an intermediate position between human and swine clusters, consistent with their evolutionary origin. Analysis of simulated reassortment further revealed that the introduction of human–origin segments into swine influenza viruses reduced their distance to the human prototype, indicating that InfluProto can detect reassortment-associated shifts in host adaptation. To facilitate broad public useaccess, we have developed an interactive web service for InfluProto. Collectively, our work establishes a continuous framework for characterizing host adaptation and evaluating zoonotic risk in influenza A viruses, with potential implications for pandemic surveillance and preparedness.

title_zh: InfluProto:通过原型学习预测甲型流感病毒的跨物种 传播
source_body_en: Zoonotic influenza A viruses pose constitute a significant persistent threat to global public health, yet quantitative approaches for assessing their cross-species transmission potential remain limited. Here, we present InfluProto, a deep learning model that introduces prototype learning into host prediction for influenza A virus, framing conceptualizing host adaptation as a continuous process rather than a discrete outcome. InfluProto embeds viral sequences into a continuous representation space anchored by human, swine, and avian prototypes, using cosine distances as a quantitative measure of host adaptation. InfluProto accurately discriminated among the three host classes, achieving recall and precision exceeding 0.97, and substantially outperformed conventional classification models models—particularly on challenging zoonotic strains, including the 2009 pandemic H1N1 (pdm09) lineage. Beyond host classification, the learned representations captured biologically meaningful host-adaptive signatures,; notably, with pdm09 viruses occupying occupied an intermediate position between human and swine clusters, consistent with their evolutionary origin. Analysis of simulated reassortment further revealed that the introduction of human–origin segments into swine influenza viruses reduced their distance to the human prototype, indicating that InfluProto can detect reassortment-associated shifts in host adaptation. To facilitate broad public useaccess, we have developed an interactive web service for InfluProto. Collectively, our work establishes a continuous framework for characterizing host adaptation and evaluating zoonotic risk in influenza A viruses, with potential implications for pandemic surveillance and preparedness.

title: School-age Children as the Dominant Source of Inter-seasonal Influenza Circulation in the Republic of Korea, 2022–2025
abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza circulates at low levels during summer inter-seasonal periods, potentially bridging consecutive epidemics. Which age groups contribute most to this residual circulation is not well characterized. METHODS: We analyzed weekly influenza detection rates from the Korea Sentinel Surveillance System (K-SenS), stratified by 6 age groups, from 2022 to 2025 (209 weeks). The inter-season was defined as epidemiologic weeks 21-39. For each age group, we calculated the mean inter-season detection rate, the residual fraction (inter-season rate/season rate), dominance weeks (weeks with the highest detection rate), lag-1 autocorrelation of weekly rates and normalized post-peak decay curves. RESULTS: Influenza was detected during the inter-season in all age groups. Mean inter-season detection rates were highest in children 7-12 years (6.3%) and 13-18 years old (5.2%). The residual fraction was similar across all ages (19.6%-25.6%). However, children 7-12 years old had the highest detection rate in 42% of active inter-season weeks and showed the highest lag-1 autocorrelation (0.44), indicating sustained rather than sporadic circulation. At 15 weeks after the season peak, children 7-12 years of age retained approximately 55% of their peak detection rate, compared with below 10% in adults ≥50 years old. CONCLUSIONS: School-age children, particularly those 7-12 years of age, were the dominant source of inter-seasonal influenza circulation in Korea. Their dominance was driven by high seasonal burden rather than slower viral clearance. Maintaining high vaccination coverage in this age group may help reduce inter-seasonal virus reservoirs.

title_zh: 学龄儿童是韩国 季节性流感 流通的主要来源,2022-2025 年
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Influenza circulates at low levels during summer inter-seasonal periods, potentially bridging consecutive epidemics. Which age groups contribute most to this residual circulation is not well characterized. METHODS: We analyzed weekly influenza detection rates from the Korea Sentinel Surveillance System (K-SenS), stratified by 6 age groups, from 2022 to 2025 (209 weeks). The inter-season was defined as epidemiologic weeks 21-39. For each age group, we calculated the mean inter-season detection rate, the residual fraction (inter-season rate/season rate), dominance weeks (weeks with the highest detection rate), lag-1 autocorrelation of weekly rates and normalized post-peak decay curves. RESULTS: Influenza was detected during the inter-season in all age groups. Mean inter-season detection rates were highest in children 7-12 years (6.3%) and 13-18 years old (5.2%). The residual fraction was similar across all ages (19.6%-25.6%). However, children 7-12 years old had the highest detection rate in 42% of active inter-season weeks and showed the highest lag-1 autocorrelation (0.44), indicating sustained rather than sporadic circulation. At 15 weeks after the season peak, children 7-12 years of age retained approximately 55% of their peak detection rate, compared with below 10% in adults ≥50 years old. CONCLUSIONS: School-age children, particularly those 7-12 years of age, were the dominant source of inter-seasonal influenza circulation in Korea. Their dominance was driven by high seasonal burden rather than slower viral clearance. Maintaining high vaccination coverage in this age group may help reduce inter-seasonal virus reservoirs.
abstract_zh: 背景:流感在夏季跨季节期间低水平传播,可能会弥合连续的流行病。哪些年龄组对残余循环的贡献最大尚不清楚。方法:我们分析了 2022 年至 2025 年(209 周)韩国前哨 监测 系统 (K-SenS) 的每周流感检出率,按 6 个年龄组分层。季节间被定义为流行病学周 21-39。对于每个年龄组,我们计算了平均季节间检测率、剩余分数(季节间率/季节率)、优势周(检测率最高的周)、周率的 lag-1 自相关和归一化的峰值后衰减曲线。结果:季节间期间所有年龄组均检测到流感。7-12 岁儿童 (6.3%) 和 13-18 岁儿童 (5.2%) 的平均跨季节检出率最高。所有年龄段的残余分数相似(19.6%-25.6%)。然而,7-12 岁儿童在活跃的季间周中的检出率最高,占 42%,并且表现出最高的 lag-1 自相关性 (0.44),表明循环是持续的而不是零星的。在季节高峰后 15 周,7-12 岁的儿童保留了大约 55% 的峰值检出率,而 ≥50 岁的成人则低于 10%。结论:学龄儿童,特别是 7-12 岁的儿童,是韩国 季节性流感 间循环的主要来源。他们的主导地位是由高季节性负担驱动的,而不是病毒清除速度较慢。在这个年龄段保持高 疫苗接种 覆盖率可能有助于减少季节性病毒 储存宿主。

title: Emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases in the Sahel: a One Health investigation of an influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 outbreak in the Abéché Health District, Chad, 2021
abstract: Emerging infectious diseases threaten global health security, particularly where integrated human-animal-environment surveillance is limited. In May 2021, Chad reported an influenza-like illness (ILI) outbreak in the Abéché Health District (Ouaddaï Province) following unusual avian mortality. We conducted a One Health investigation from May 1 to June 24, 2021, combining active case finding, a neighborhood-matched case-control study (58 cases, 58 controls) of warthog- and poultry-related exposures, an animal/environmental investigation, and virological testing (quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction [RT-qPCR] in humans; hemagglutination inhibition in poultry). We identified 210 ILI cases, 77.6% in the Amtiab villages (Abéché Health District); children under 10 were the most affected, with one death (probable encephalitis, age 13). Age under 15 years (odds ratio [OR]=4.49, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.61-12.55) and contact with a case (OR=4.39, 95% CI: 1.89-10.21) were significantly associated with ILI. RT-qPCR confirmed A(H1N1)pdm09 in humans; poultry showed prior mortality and anti-H9N2 antibodies, without an established causal link. This investigation rapidly identified an A(H1N1)pdm09 outbreak in a rural Sahelian setting where human-wildlife-poultry cohabitation and poor sanitation favor zoonotic pathogens. Young age and close contact drove the transmission. Strengthened integrated influenza surveillance and diagnostic capacity are needed in sub-Saharan Africa.
journal: Sahelian Journal of Responsible One Health

In May 2021, Chad reported an influenza-like illness (ILI) outbreak in the Abéché Health District (Ouaddaï Province) following unusual avian mortality. We conducted a One Health investigation from May 1 to June 24, 2021, combining active case finding, a neighborhood-matched case-control study (58 cases, 58 controls) of warthog- and poultry-related exposures, an animal/environmental investigation, and virological testing (quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction [RT-qPCR] in humans; hemagglutination inhibition in poultry). This investigation rapidly identified an A(H1N1)pdm09 outbreak in a rural Sahelian setting where human-wildlife-poultry cohabitation and poor sanitation favor zoonotic pathogens. Young age and close contact drove the transmission. Strengthened integrated influenza surveillance and diagnostic capacity are needed in sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Seasonal influenza vaccination among healthcare workers in Lebanese hospitals: determinants of uptake post-COVID-19 pandemic and economic crisis
abstract: Background Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at increased risk of acquiring and transmitting influenza. We assessed self-reported influenza vaccination uptake among surveyed HCWs in Lebanese hospitals during 2023–2024, compared it with their reported uptake in pre-pandemic 2018–2019, and identified factors associated with non-vaccination. Methods This cross-sectional survey was conducted from April to July 2024 among HCWs from 14 public and private hospitals across multiple regions of Lebanon. The questionnaire assessed influenza vaccination status, free institutional vaccine provision, awareness, attitudes, and COVID-19 vaccine–related perceptions. Multivariable logistic regression identified factors independently associated with non-vaccination in 2023–2024. Results Among 391 participants, self-reported influenza vaccination uptake was lower in 2023–2024 than in 2018–2019 (29.9% vs 60.5%, p < 0.0001). Free institutional vaccine provision was also lower (39.6% vs 70.1%, p < 0.0001), and 19.2% were willing to pay out of pocket. Higher odds of non-vaccination were observed among HCWs aged <30 years (aOR 3.80, 95% CI 1.96–7.68), non-physicians (aOR 5.17, 95% CI 2.26–12.42), those without free institutional vaccine provision (aOR 17.74, 95% CI 9.38–35.72), those with unfavorable influenza vaccination attitudes (aOR 4.61, 95% CI 2.10–10.63), and those with moderate-to-high COVID-19 vaccine–related hesitancy (aOR 2.09, 95% CI 1.03–4.27). Conclusion Among surveyed HCWs, influenza vaccination uptake in 2023–2024 was substantially lower than reported for 2018–2019. Lack of free institutional vaccine provision and unfavorable vaccine-related perceptions were independently associated with non-vaccination. Restoring free workplace-based vaccination and addressing COVID-19 vaccine–related hesitancy may improve uptake in resource-constrained healthcare settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 医护人员 (HCW) 感染和传播流感的风险增加。该研究旨在评估 2023 年至 2024 年黎巴嫩医院医护人员对流感 疫苗接种 的吸收情况,并将其与大流行前的 2018 年至 2019 年数据进行比较,以确定与非 疫苗接种 相关的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面调查于 2024 年 4 月至 7 月在黎巴嫩多个地区的 14 家公立和私立医院的医护人员中进行。该研究共有 391 名参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 该调查问卷评估了流感 疫苗接种 状态、免费机构 疫苗 提供、意识、态度和 COVID-19 疫苗 相关认知。多变量逻辑回归确定了 2023-2024 年与非 疫苗接种 独立相关的因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在年龄 <30 岁的医护人员、非医生、没有免费机构 疫苗 服务的人员、对流感 疫苗接种 持不利态度的人员以及具有中度至高度的 COVID-19 疫苗 相关犹豫的人员中,观察到非 疫苗接种 的几率较高。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,恢复基于工作场所的免费 疫苗接种 并解决 疫苗 犹豫问题可以提高资源有限的医疗机构中流感 疫苗接种 的吸收率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入回忆偏差。由于横截面设计和对调查答复的依赖,证据的强度适中。

title: Mutational fitness landscapes of diverse human influenza H1N1 neuraminidases
abstract: ABSTRACT While neuraminidase (NA) is emerging as a promising influenza vaccine target, it evolves rapidly and undergoes antigenic drift. However, our understanding of its evolutionary constraints remains limited. Here, we systematically quantified the replication fitness effects of >6,000 mutations for each of three antigenically diverse H1N1 NAs using deep mutational scanning. Moderate correlations among H1N1 NA fitness landscapes revealed mutations with strain-dependent replication fitness effects. Additionally, cross-subtype comparison between N1 and N2 NAs uncovered similar epistatic effects that were enriched in the C-terminal interprotomer interface. We also showed that NA mutational fitness strongly correlated between in vivo and in vitro . Characterization of 40 individually constructed NA mutants further demonstrated that NA mutational fitness depended more on its surface protein expression than on its total protein expression or endoplasmic reticulum stress induction. Overall, the large dataset generated in this work provides critical insights into the evolutionary constraints of NA.

title: Targeted Next-Generation Sequencing Reveals Co-infection Patterns and Risk Factors for Severe Pneumonia in Influenza A(H1N1) pdm09
abstract: Abstract Background Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 remains a major cause of seasonal respiratory morbidity, yet predictors of progression to severe pneumonia and the associated co-infection profile remain incompletely characterized. This study aimed to describe the clinical features, laboratory abnormalities, pathogen spectrum, and risk factors for severe influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 pneumonia using targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS). Methods In this retrospective single-center study, hospitalized patients admitted to Panyu Central Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University between January and December 2024 were analyzed. Based on tNGS and clinical classification, 175 patients infected with influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 were included, comprising 92 mild cases and 83 severe pneumonia cases; 121 non-H1N1 respiratory infection cases served as controls. Demographic data, symptoms, comorbidities, blood routine and biochemical indices, and co-infection profiles were compared. Uni- and multivariate logistic regression were used to identify risk factors for severe disease. Results Severe pneumonia was more common in older patients and was associated with higher body mass index (BMI), greater rates of hypertension, diabetes, smoking exposure, and longer hospitalization. Compared with mild cases, severe cases showed more frequent cough, dyspnea, nasal congestion/rhinorrhea, neutrophilia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, reduced eGFR, elevated creatinine, liver enzyme abnormalities, and increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate. tNGS revealed distinct co-infection patterns: mild cases were predominantly bacterial, with Haemophilus influenzae as the leading pathogen, whereas severe cases had significantly higher fungal co-infection rates, particularly Candida albicans and Aspergillus fumigatus, and more Epstein-Barr virus detection. In multivariate analysis, age, BMI, cough, dyspnea, and nasal congestion/rhinorrhea were independent risk factors for severe pneumonia, while headache was protective. Conclusion Severe influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 pneumonia is characterized by advanced age, elevated BMI, respiratory symptoms, systemic inflammation, organ dysfunction, and a shift toward fungal/viral co-infection. Early risk stratification and pathogen-directed management may improve outcomes in high-risk patients.

title_zh: 靶向下一代测序揭示甲型 H1N1 流感 pdm09 的合并感染模式和严重肺炎的危险因素
source_body_en: Abstract Background Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 remains a major cause of seasonal respiratory morbidity, yet predictors of progression to severe pneumonia and the associated co-infection profile remain incompletely characterized. This study aimed to describe the clinical features, laboratory abnormalities, pathogen spectrum, and risk factors for severe influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 pneumonia using targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS). Methods In this retrospective single-center study, hospitalized patients admitted to Panyu Central Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University between January and December 2024 were analyzed. Based on tNGS and clinical classification, 175 patients infected with influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 were included, comprising 92 mild cases and 83 severe pneumonia cases; 121 non-H1N1 respiratory infection cases served as controls. Demographic data, symptoms, comorbidities, blood routine and biochemical indices, and co-infection profiles were compared. Uni- and multivariate logistic regression were used to identify risk factors for severe disease. Results Severe pneumonia was more common in older patients and was associated with higher body mass index (BMI), greater rates of hypertension, diabetes, smoking exposure, and longer hospitalization. Compared with mild cases, severe cases showed more frequent cough, dyspnea, nasal congestion/rhinorrhea, neutrophilia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, reduced eGFR, elevated creatinine, liver enzyme abnormalities, and increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate. tNGS revealed distinct co-infection patterns: mild cases were predominantly bacterial, with Haemophilus influenzae as the leading pathogen, whereas severe cases had significantly higher fungal co-infection rates, particularly Candida albicans and Aspergillus fumigatus, and more Epstein-Barr virus detection. In multivariate analysis, age, BMI, cough, dyspnea, and nasal congestion/rhinorrhea were independent risk factors for severe pneumonia, while headache was protective. Conclusion Severe influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 pneumonia is characterized by advanced age, elevated BMI, respiratory symptoms, systemic inflammation, organ dysfunction, and a shift toward fungal/viral co-infection. Early risk stratification and pathogen-directed management may improve outcomes in high-risk patients.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 流感 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 仍然是季节性呼吸道疾病的主要原因,但进展为严重肺炎的预测因素以及相关的合并感染特征仍未完全确定。本研究旨在利用靶向下一代测序(tNGS)描述重症流感 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 肺炎的临床特征、实验室异常、病原体谱和危险因素。方法 本回顾性单中心研究对2024年1月至12月广州医科大学番禺中心医院收治的住院患者进行分析。根据tNGS和临床分型,纳入175例流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09感染患者,其中轻症92例,重症肺炎83例;121例非H1N1呼吸道感染病例作为对照。比较人口统计数据、症状、合并症、血常规和生化指标以及合并感染情况。使用单变量和多变量逻辑回归来确定严重疾病的危险因素。结果 重症肺炎在老年患者中更为常见,并且与较高的体重指数 (BMI)、较高的高血压、糖尿病、吸烟暴露和较长的住院时间相关。与轻症病例相比,重症病例更常出现咳嗽、呼吸困难、鼻塞/鼻漏、中性粒细胞增多、淋巴细胞减少、血小板减少、eGFR降低、肌酐升高、肝酶异常、红细胞沉降率升高等症状。tNGS揭示了不同的合并感染模式:轻症病例以细菌为主,以流感嗜血杆菌为主要病原体,而重症病例的真菌合并感染率明显较高,特别是白色念珠菌和烟曲霉,并且检出更多EB病毒。多变量分析显示,年龄、BMI、咳嗽、呼吸困难和鼻塞/鼻漏是重症肺炎的独立危险因素,而头痛具有保护作用。结论 重症流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09肺炎的特点是高龄、BMI升高、呼吸道症状、全身炎症、器官功能障碍以及向真菌/病毒合并感染的转变。早期风险分层和针对病原体的管理可能会改善高危患者的预后。

title: Maternal Influenza Infection During Pregnancy and Neuropsychiatric Disorders in Offspring
abstract: Importance: Evidence on maternal influenza infection during pregnancy and offspring neuropsychiatric risk remains inconsistent and limited by methodologic concerns. Objective: To evaluate the association of maternal influenza infection during pregnancy and offspring neuropsychiatric risk. Design, Setting, and Participants: This binational cohort study included mother-child pairs from the National Health Insurance Service birth cohort in South Korea (discovery cohort) and the JMDC (previously Japan Medical Data Center) birth cohort in Japan (replication cohort). Children born between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2017, were included in the study and followed up until December 31, 2023. Exposure: A first recorded maternal influenza diagnosis during pregnancy. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcome was first postnatal diagnosis of any neuropsychiatric disorder in offspring, including severe neuropsychiatric disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorder, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, autism spectrum disorder, and intellectual disability. Stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting was applied to adjust for confounding. Weighted Cox proportional hazards models estimated adjusted hazard ratios (AHRs) and 95% CIs. Subgroup analyses were conducted by trimester and season of infection, and sibling-comparison analyses used exposure-discordant sibling pairs. Data analysis was performed from September 2025 to July 2026. Results: The discovery cohort included 2 564 435 mother-child pairs (mean [SD] maternal age, 31.9 [4.1] years; 1 293 773 [50.5%] male offspring), of whom 35 973 (1.4%) were exposed to maternal influenza during pregnancy. The replication cohort included 181 681 pairs (92 738 [51.0%] male offspring), of whom 11 198 (6.2%) were exposed. In stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting-based analyses, maternal influenza infection was associated with an increased risk of any neuropsychiatric disorder in the discovery cohort (AHR, 1.09; 95% CI, 1.04-1.14) and replication cohort (AHR, 1.10; 95% CI, 1.02-1.19). Sibling-comparison analyses included 33 191 and 7842 mother-child pairs in the discovery and replication cohorts, respectively; there was not a statistically significant association in the discovery cohort (AHR, 0.98; 95% CI, 0.89-1.09) and replication cohort (AHR, 1.04; 95% CI, 0.88-1.22). Conclusions and Relevance: In this binational cohort study of mother-child pairs in South Korea and Japan, the modest population-level association between maternal influenza infection during pregnancy and the risk of any neuropsychiatric disorder in offspring was attenuated and not statistically significant in sibling-comparison analyses in either cohort. These findings suggest that familial factors may account for the association observed in the population-level analysis.

Exposure: A first recorded maternal influenza diagnosis during pregnancy. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcome was first postnatal diagnosis of any neuropsychiatric disorder in offspring, including severe neuropsychiatric disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorder, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, autism spectrum disorder, and intellectual disability. Stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting was applied to adjust for confounding. Weighted Cox proportional hazards models estimated adjusted hazard ratios (AHRs) and 95% CIs. Subgroup analyses were conducted by trimester and season of infection, and sibling-comparison analyses used exposure-discordant sibling pairs. Data analysis was performed from September 2025 to July 2026. Results: The discovery cohort included 2 564 435 mother-child pairs (mean [SD] maternal age, 31.9 [4.1] years; 1 293 773 [50.5%] male offspring), of whom 35 973 (1.4%) were exposed to maternal influenza during pregnancy. The replication cohort included 181 681 pairs (92 738 [51.0%] male offspring), of whom 11 198 (6.2%) were exposed. In stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting-based analyses, maternal influenza infection was associated with an increased risk of any neuropsychiatric disorder in the discovery cohort (AHR, 1.09; 95% CI, 1.04-1.14) and replication cohort (AHR, 1.10; 95% CI, 1.02-1.19). Sibling-comparison analyses included 33 191 and 7842 mother-child pairs in the discovery and replication cohorts, respectively; there was not a statistically significant association in the discovery cohort (AHR, 0.98; 95% CI, 0.89-1.09) and replication cohort (AHR, 1.04; 95% CI, 0.88-1.22). Conclusions and Relevance: In this binational cohort study of mother-child pairs in South Korea and Japan, the modest population-level association between maternal influenza infection during pregnancy and the risk of any neuropsychiatric disorder in offspring was attenuated and not statistically significant in sibling-comparison analyses in either cohort. These findings suggest that familial factors may account for the association observed in the population-level analysis.

abstract_zh: 重要性:关于妊娠期间母亲流感感染与后代神经精神疾病风险的证据仍不一致且受到方法学问题的限制。目的:评估妊娠期间母亲流感感染与后代神经精神疾病风险的关联。设计、地点和参与者:这项跨国队列研究研究包括来自韩国国家健康保险服务出生队列研究(发现队列研究)和日本JMDC(原日本医疗数据中心)出生队列研究(复制队列研究)的母子对。研究纳入了2010年1月1日至2017年12月31日出生的儿童,并随访至2023年12月31日。暴露:妊娠期间首次记录的母亲流感诊断。主要结局和测量指标:主要结局是后代任何神经精神疾病的首次产后诊断,包括严重的神经精神疾病、强迫症、注意力缺陷/多动障碍、自闭症谱系障碍和智力残疾。采用稳定逆概率治疗加权分析来调整混杂因素。加权Cox比例风险模型估计了调整后的风险比(AHRs)和95%置信区间(CI)。进行了按感染孕周和季节的亚组分析,并使用暴露不一致的兄弟姐妹对进行兄弟姐妹比较分析。数据分析于2025年9月至2026年7月进行。结果:发现队列研究包括2,564,435对母子(母亲平均年龄[标准差]为31.9[4.1]岁;1,293,773[50.5%]名男性后代),其中35,973(1.4%)对在妊娠期间暴露于母亲流感感染。复制队列研究包括181,681对母子(其中92,738[51.0%]名男性后代),其中11,198(6.2%)对暴露于母亲流感感染。在基于稳定逆概率治疗加权分析的模型中,妊娠期间母亲流感感染与发现队列研究中后代任何神经精神疾病风险增加相关(AHR为1.09;95% CI为1.04-1.14),以及复制队列研究中相关(AHR为1.10;95% CI为1.02-1.19)。兄弟姐妹比较分析包括发现队列研究中的33,191对和复制队列研究中的7,842对母子;在发现队列研究中未发现统计学显著关联(AHR为0.98;95% CI为0.89-1.09),在复制队列研究中也未发现统计学显著关联(AHR为1.04;95% CI为0.88-1.22)。结论和相关性:在这项涉及韩国和日本母子对的跨国队列研究研究中,妊娠期间母亲流感感染与后代任何神经精神疾病风险之间存在适度的群体水平关联,但在发现队列研究和复制队列研究的兄弟姐妹比较分析中,该关联被减弱且不具有统计学显著性。这些发现表明,家族因素可能解释了群体水平分析中观察到的关联。

title: The antigenic landscape of N1 neuraminidase in human influenza A virus strains isolated between 2009 and 2020
abstract: The immunogen composition of seasonal influenza vaccines is revised biannually to match the antigenic drift of the hemagglutinin of circulating influenza virus strains. Antibodies directed against the influenza neuraminidase also correlate with protection against influenza, yet the antigenic evolution of influenza neuraminidase remains underexplored. To evaluate the antigenic diversity of N1 neuraminidase, we generated a panel of immune sera in mice directed against 17 N1 neuraminidases derived from human H1N1 strains that were isolated between 2009 and 2020 and determined the neuraminidase inhibition (NAI) titers of these sera against a panel of 14 HxN1 viruses. The selected N1 neuraminidases cluster into two major phylogenetic groups while the NAI pattern revealed two antigenic groups corresponding to early and more recent H1N1 viruses. Sera raised against early N1 NAs inhibited NA activity from both early and recent H1N1 viruses equally well, whereas sera raised against more recent N1 NAs showed stronger NAI against recent H1N1 strains, indicating an asymmetric antigenic relationship between the two antigenic groups. Random forest modeling of antigenic distances indicated that the I321V, N386K/S and K432E substitutions played an important role in the N1 NA antigenic variation. Reverse-genetics experiments using mutant strains revealed that the N386K substitution in an early H1N1 virus increased susceptibility to inhibition by sera raised against recent N1 NAs, consistent with a role for the loss of the N-linked glycosylation motif and the acquisition of a lysine at this position near the lateral surface of the NA head. However, reciprocal substitutions in a recent N1 background did not restore the early antigenic phenotype, indicating a unidirectional effect. This finding suggests that anti-NA responses elicited against early pandemic H1N1 viruses remained effective against circulating N1 variants up to at least 2020.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决尚未开发的流感神经氨酸酶抗原 进化,这对于 疫苗 的开发至关重要,因为 季节性流感 疫苗 的免疫原组成每半年修订一次,以匹配循环流感病毒株血凝素的 抗原漂移。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及在小鼠中生成一组针对源自 2009 年至 2020 年间分离的人类 H1N1 病毒株的 17 种 N1 神经氨酸酶的免疫血清,并确定这些血清针对一组 14 种 HxN1 病毒的神经氨酸酶抑制 (NAI) 滴度。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用反向遗传学实验来评估特定取代在 N1 神经氨酸酶抗原变异中的作用,并应用随机森林模型来分析基于 NAI 滴度的抗原距离。
elements_zh.main_results: 所选的 N1 神经氨酸酶聚类为两个主要的系统发育群,NAI 模式揭示了与早期和较近期的 H1N1 病毒相对应的两个抗原组。针对早期 N1 NA 的血清对早期和近期 H1N1 病毒的 NA 活性具有同样的抑制作用,而针对较近期 N1 NA 的血清对近期 H1N1 病毒株表现出更强的 NAI。反向遗传学实验表明,早期 H1N1 病毒中的 N386K 取代增加了对近期 N1 NA 血清抑制的敏感性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,两组之间存在不对称抗原关系,针对早期大流行 H1N1 病毒的抗 NA 反应至少到 2020 年仍然对循环的 N1 变种有效。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明,N1 神经氨酸酶的抗原性 进化 可能会影响抗 NA 反应的有效性,这可以为 疫苗 设计和 季节性流感 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到小鼠模型的使用以及 免疫应答 中物种特异性差异的可能性的限制,但由于对抗原距离的详细分析和替代的实验验证,证据是强有力的。

abstract_zh: 季节性流感 疫苗 的免疫原组成每半年修订一次,以匹配流行流感病毒株的血凝素 抗原漂移。针对流感神经氨酸酶的抗体也与针对流感的保护相关,但流感神经氨酸酶的抗原性 进化 仍未得到充分研究。为了评估 N1 神经氨酸酶的抗原多样性,我们在小鼠中生成了一组针对源自 2009 年至 2020 年间分离的人类 H1N1 毒株的 17 种 N1 神经氨酸酶的免疫血清,并测定了这些血清针对一组 14 种 HxN1 病毒的神经氨酸酶抑制 (NAI) 效价。选定的 N1 神经氨酸酶聚类为两个主要的系统发育组,而 NAI 模式揭示了与早期和较近期的 H1N1 病毒相对应的两个抗原组。针对早期 N1 NA 的血清对早期和近期 H1N1 病毒的 NA 活性具有同样的抑制作用,而针对较近期 N1 NA 的血清对近期 H1N1 病毒株表现出更强的 NAI,表明两个抗原组之间存在不对称抗原关系。抗原距离的随机森林模型表明,I321V、N386K/S 和 K432E 取代在 N1 NA 抗原变异中发挥重要作用。使用突变株的反向遗传学实验表明,早期 H1N1 病毒中的 N386K 取代增加了对最近 N1 NA 血清抑制的敏感性,这与 N 连接糖基化基序的丢失和在 NA 头侧面附近的位置获得赖氨酸的作用一致。然而,最近 N1 背景中的相互替换并没有恢复早期抗原表型,表明单向效应。这一发现表明,针对早期大流行 H1N1 病毒引发的抗 NA 反应至少到 2020 年仍能有效对抗流行的 N1 变种。

title: Self-Assembling Nanoparticles to Assess Multivalent Interactions between Influenza A Virus Hemagglutinin and Glycan Surfaces
abstract: The multivalent display of surface glycoprotein hemagglutinin (HA) on Influenza A viruses (IAVs) enhances the overall binding avidity to sialylated glycans on host cell surfaces. While precomplexing HA trimers with antibodies increases multivalency and avidity, this method does not replicate the virion's geometry and limits insights into the multivalent binding process. Here, we use perfectly controllable icosahedral protein nanoparticles to examine the multivalent HA receptor-binding properties. We compare three HA presentation systems with varying degrees of multivalency: single HA trimers, antibody-precomplexed HA trimers, and HA trimers on nanoparticles. Our results indicate that increasing HA valency enhances binding avidity across various glycan surfaces, including erythrocytes, cells, and lipid bilayers with varying glycan densities, while maintaining receptor specificity. By combining functional and nonfunctional HA trimers during nanoparticle formation, we create statistical mixtures of nanoparticles with varying valencies. At high receptor densities, nanoparticles with few functional trimers still bind strongly, whereas at low receptor densities, a patch of five HA trimers appears necessary for binding. As a key finding, we observe that such a statistical mixture of nanoparticles with functional and nonfunctional HAs binds to glycan surfaces in a stronger density-dependent manner than fully functional particles. We also observe differences in binding modes that correlate with the number of functional trimers, the glycan structure (linear vs branched), and the densities achievable with these glycans. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the presentation of multivalent HA plays an enormous role in the response to glycan receptor type and density, with implications for the future design of virus monitoring, viral inhibitors, and targeting vectors.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how the multivalent display of hemagglutinin (HA) on Influenza A viruses (IAVs) influences binding avidity to sialylated glycans on host cell surfaces, addressing a gap in knowledge about the role of HA valency in viral interactions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used perfectly controllable icosahedral protein nanoparticles to examine the multivalent HA receptor-binding properties, comparing three HA presentation systems: single HA trimers, antibody-precomplexed HA trimers, and HA trimers on nanoparticles.
analysis.methods: The researchers created statistical mixtures of nanoparticles with varying valencies by combining functional and nonfunctional HA trimers during nanoparticle formation and assessed their binding to glycan surfaces with different structures and densities.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that increasing HA valency enhances binding avidity across various glycan surfaces, including erythrocytes, cells, and lipid bilayers, while maintaining receptor specificity. At high receptor densities, nanoparticles with few functional trimers still bind strongly, whereas at low receptor densities, a patch of five HA trimers appears necessary for binding.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the multivalent presentation of HA significantly affects the response to glycan receptor type and density, offering novel insights into how HA binding can be modulated by valency.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings have implications for the future design of virus monitoring, viral inhibitors, and targeting vectors, potentially informing strategies for improving vaccine and antiviral development.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is strong, as it uses a controlled experimental system to examine HA valency effects, but it does not account for in vivo conditions or natural viral variations, which may limit generalizability.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how the multivalent display of hemagglutinin (HA) on Influenza A viruses (IAVs) influences their binding avidity to sialylated glycans on host cell surfaces. Using icosahedral protein nanoparticles, the researchers compare three HA presentation systems: single HA trimers, antibody-precomplexed HA trimers, and HA trimers on nanoparticles. They find that increasing HA valency enhances binding avidity across various glycan surfaces, including erythrocytes, cells, and lipid bilayers, while maintaining receptor specificity. At high receptor densities, nanoparticles with few functional trimers still bind strongly, whereas at low receptor densities, a patch of five HA trimers appears necessary for binding. The authors interpret that HA valency plays a significant role in the response to glycan receptor type and density, offering novel insights for improving virus monitoring, inhibitors, and targeting vectors. The study's controlled experimental design provides strong evidence, but its findings may not fully generalize to in vivo conditions or natural viral variations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 上血凝素 (HA) 的多价展示如何影响 宿主 细胞表面唾液酸化聚糖的结合亲和力,从而弥补有关 HA 价在病毒相互作用中的作用的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用完全可控的二十面体蛋白纳米颗粒来检查多价 HA 受体结合特性,比较了三种 HA 呈递系统:单一 HA 三聚体、抗体预复合的 HA 三聚体和纳米颗粒上的 HA 三聚体。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过在纳米颗粒形成过程中结合功能性和非功能性 HA 三聚体,创建了具有不同化合价的纳米颗粒的统计混合物,并评估了它们与不同结构和密度的聚糖表面的结合。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,增加 HA 价数可增强跨各种聚糖表面(包括红细胞、细胞和脂质双层)的结合亲合力,同时保持受体特异性。在高受体密度下,具有少量功能性三聚体的纳米颗粒仍然牢固结合,而在低受体密度下,五个 HA 三聚体的补丁似乎需要结合。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,HA 的多价呈现显着影响对聚糖受体类型和密度的反应,为 HA 结合如何通过价态调节提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对病毒监测、病毒抑制剂和靶向 媒介 的未来设计具有影响,可能为改进 疫苗 和 抗病毒药物 开发的策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据是强有力的,因为它使用受控实验系统来检查HA价效应,但它没有考虑体内条件或自然病毒变异,这可能会限制普遍性。

title_zh: 自组装纳米颗粒评估甲型流感病毒血凝素与聚糖表面之间的多价相互作用

abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 上表面糖蛋白血凝素 (HA) 的多价展示增强了 宿主 细胞表面唾液酸化聚糖的整体结合亲和力。虽然 HA 三聚体与抗体预复合可增加多价性和亲合力,但该方法无法复制病毒粒子的几何形状,并限制了对多价结合过程的了解。在这里,我们使用完全可控的二十面体蛋白质纳米粒子来检查多价 HA 受体结合特性。我们比较了三种具有不同多价程度的HA呈现系统:单一HA三聚体、抗体预复合HA三聚体和纳米颗粒上的HA三聚体。我们的结果表明,增加HA价数可以增强跨各种聚糖表面的结合亲和力,包括红细胞、细胞和具有不同聚糖密度的脂质双层,同时保持受体特异性。通过在纳米颗粒形成过程中结合功能性和非功能性 HA 三聚体,我们创建了具有不同化合价的纳米颗粒的统计混合物。在高受体密度下,具有少量功能性三聚体的纳米颗粒仍然牢固结合,而在低受体密度下,五个 HA 三聚体的补丁似乎需要结合。作为一项重要发现,我们观察到,这种具有功能性和非功能性 HA 的纳米颗粒的统计混合物比全功能颗粒以更强的密度依赖性方式与聚糖表面结合。我们还观察到与功能三聚体数量、聚糖结构(线性与支链)以及这些聚糖可实现的密度相关的结合模式的差异。总体而言,我们的研究结果表明,多价 HA 的呈现在聚糖受体类型和密度的反应中发挥着巨大作用,对病毒监测、病毒抑制剂和靶向 媒介 的未来设计具有影响。

title: Enrollment in participatory surveillance programs and influenza vaccination uptake: A systematic review protocol
abstract: BACKGROUND: Despite the availability of effective vaccines, seasonal influenza remains a substantial global public health concern. Suboptimal influenza vaccination uptake is found across many populations. Using digital platforms, individuals can self-report health information through participatory surveillance programs. Though they are mainly used for infectious disease monitoring, their potential association with preventive behaviors such as influenza vaccination uptake has not been systematically evaluated. This review is necessary and urgent given the recurrent influenza outbreaks and the severity of illness due to low vaccination rates. OBJECTIVE: This protocol details the design and methodology of a systematic review that will assess whether enrollment in participatory surveillance programs is associated with differences in seasonal influenza vaccination uptake compared with non-participation. METHODS: This systematic review protocol follows the Cochrane guidelines, is reported according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Protocols (PRISMA-P), and is registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251274024). Eligible studies will include quantitative comparative designs, including randomized controlled trials, as well as observational and quasi-experimental studies with appropriate comparators. The population will comprise individuals eligible for influenza vaccination in settings where participatory surveillance programs are available. The primary outcome is influenza vaccination uptake. Searches will be conducted in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus, CABI Global Health, and CINAHL, alongside selected grey literature sources, without restrictions on language, geography, or publication date. Two reviewers will independently screen studies, extract data using Covidence, and assess risk of bias using ROB 2 and ROBINS-I. Where appropriate, data will be synthesized using meta-analysis or narrative methods. Heterogeneity will be described using I2, and certainty assessed using GRADE. CONCLUSIONS: This systematic review will provide an urgently needed summary of evidence regarding the association between participatory surveillance enrollment and influenza vaccination uptake. Findings will inform future research and the development of digital public health strategies that integrate disease surveillance and health promotion.

abstract_zh: 背景:尽管存在有效的 疫苗,季节性流感 仍然是全球公共卫生的一个重大问题。许多人群对流感 疫苗接种 的吸收情况不佳。使用数字平台,个人可以通过参与性 监测 计划自我报告健康信息。虽然它们主要用于传染病监测,但它们与流感 疫苗接种 摄取等预防行为的潜在关联尚未得到系统评估。鉴于 暴发 流感复发以及 疫苗接种 发病率低导致的疾病严重程度,此次审查是必要且紧迫的。目的:本方案详细介绍了系统评价的设计和方法,该评价将评估参与性 监测 计划的注册是否与 季节性流感 疫苗接种 吸收与未参与相比的差异相关。方法:该系统评价方案遵循 Cochrane 指南,根据系统评价和荟萃分析方案的首选报告项目 (PRISMA-P) 进行报告,并在 PROSPERO 中注册 (CRD420251274024)。合格的研究将包括定量比较设计,包括随机对照试验,以及使用适当比较器的观察性和准实验研究。该人群将包括在有参与性 监测 计划的环境中符合流感 疫苗接种 资格的个体。主要结果是流感 疫苗接种 的摄取。检索将在 PubMed、Embase、Cochrane CENTRAL、Scopus、CABI Global Health 和 CINAHL 以及选定的灰色文献来源中进行,不受语言、地理位置或出版日期的限制。两名评审员将独立筛选研究,使用 Covidence 提取数据,并使用 ROB 2 和 ROBINS-I 评估偏倚风险。在适当的情况下,将使用荟萃分析或叙述方法来综合数据。将使用 I2 描述异质性,并使用 GRADE 评估确定性。结论:本系统评价将提供关于参与性 监测 注册与流感 疫苗接种 摄取之间关联的迫切需要的证据总结。研究结果将为未来的研究和数字公共卫生战略的制定提供信息,这些战略将疾病 监测 与健康促进相结合。

title: Costs of influenza-associated healthcare: an umbrella review and meta-regression analysis
abstract: Abstract Background Estimates of the healthcare costs associated with influenza treatment are essential for cost-effectiveness analyses that inform preventative and treatment strategies such as vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions. Existing evidence varies across treatment settings, age groups, and countries and there is little data from low- and middle-income settings. Methods We conducted an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses reporting direct admitted and non-admitted hospitalisation costs of seasonal influenza treatment in children, adults, and older people. We supplemented an evidence gap with a systematised review of studies reporting adult non-admitted treatment costs. Costs were extracted and adjusted to 2023 USD. We fitted a Bayesian mixed-effects model to estimate influenza treatment costs using national economic indicators, age group, and treatment setting as a priori predictors. We predicted admitted and non-admitted treatment costs for children, adults, and older people in 195 countries and territories. Results Seven reviews were included in the umbrella review, supplemented by 17 primary studies for adult non-admitted care. Extracted data points most frequently described admitted treatment costs and came from high-income countries. The best-fitting model used healthcare expenditure per capita to predict treatment costs, with country-level random effects. Estimated costs increased with healthcare expenditure per capita, were higher for admitted than non-admitted care, and were highest for adults and lowest for children. Conclusions This study provides novel estimates of influenza-associated healthcare costs across age groups and treatment settings by synthesising the available global evidence. By extrapolating to settings without data, our estimates can inform future economic evaluation studies of influenza interventions worldwide.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to estimate healthcare costs associated with seasonal influenza treatment across different age groups and settings. An umbrella review of seven systematic reviews and meta-analyses, supplemented by 17 primary studies, was conducted to gather data on direct admitted and non-admitted hospitalisation costs. The analysis revealed that treatment costs increased with healthcare expenditure per capita, were higher for admitted care, and were highest for adults and lowest for children. The findings provide novel estimates that can inform economic evaluations of influenza interventions globally. However, the study's data primarily came from high-income countries, limiting its applicability to low- and middle-income settings. The evidence is strong due to the systematic synthesis of global data, but the extrapolation to settings without direct data introduces uncertainty.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 与流感 治疗 相关的医疗保健成本的估计对于成本效益分析至关重要,为预防性和 治疗 策略(例如 疫苗接种 和非药物干预措施)提供信息。现有证据因 治疗 环境、年龄组和国家而异,并且来自低收入和中等收入环境的数据很少。方法 我们对系统评价和荟萃分析进行了总体审查,报告了 季节性流感 治疗 在儿童、成人和老年人中的直接入院和非入院住院费用。我们通过对报告成人非入院 治疗 费用的研究进行系统审查,补充了证据差距。提取成本并调整为 2023 美元。我们安装了贝叶斯混合效应模型,使用国民经济指标、年龄组和 治疗 设置作为先验预测因子来估计流感 治疗 成本。我们预测了 195 个国家和地区的儿童、成人和老年人的住院和非住院 治疗 费用。结果 总体评价中纳入了 7 项评价,并辅以 17 项针对成人非入院护理的初步研究。最常描述的提取数据点承认 治疗 成本并且来自高收入国家。最拟合模型使用人均医疗保健支出来预测 治疗 成本,并具有国家级随机效应。估计费用随着人均医疗保健支出的增加而增加,入院护理的费用高于非入院护理的费用,并且成人最高,儿童最低。结论 本研究通过综合现有的全球证据,对跨年龄组和 治疗 环境的流感相关医疗费用提供了新的估计。通过推断没有数据的环境,我们的估计可以为未来全球流感干预措施的经济评估研究提供信息。

title: Sequence-Aware Antigenic Alignment and SRID Potency Interpretation in Influenza Vaccines
abstract: Single radial immunodiffusion (SRID) remains the standard potency assay for seasonal influenza vaccines worldwide. Because SRID depends on antigen-antibody recognition, hemagglutinin (HA) sequence variation can influence potency interpretation through its effects on antigenic alignment among vaccine antigens and reference reagents. This review examines the relationship between viral propagation, antigenic fidelity, and reference reagent alignment, and proposes sequence-aware antigenic alignment as a conceptual framework linking HA sequence variation to SRID potency interpretation and harmonization.

title: Pre-existing cross-subtype serological responses against H5Nx in health care workers
abstract: UNLABELLED: A rise in cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in humans has been reported since 2023. Although influenza seasonal vaccination (H1N1/H3N2) was shown to be effective against cases of reinfection with endemic influenza A viruses (IAVs), its capacity to elicit cross-reactive antibodies against (H5N1) remains unclear. Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

title: Matrix Metalloproteinase-8 Deficiency Alters the Balance Between Viral Clearance and Immunopathology in H1N1 Infection.
abstract: ABSTRACT Matrix metalloproteinase‐8 (MMP‐8) regulates inflammatory responses, but its contributions to the pathogenesis of influenza A viral (IAV) disease are not known. Plasma MMP‐8 levels were increased 30‐fold in subjects infected with H1N1 or seasonal IAV and were inversely associated with the PaO 2 /FiO 2 ratio, suggesting potential value as a candidate marker of lung injury severity that requires validation in larger cohorts. MMP‐8 levels were elevated in the lungs of H1N1‐infected wild‐type (WT) mice and localized to airway epithelial cells, macrophages, and polymorphonuclear neutrophils (PMNs). H1N1‐infected Mmp‐8 −/− mice exhibited lower mortality and reduced lung viral burdens, but developed more severe lung injury than WT mice. Gene expression profiling revealed enhanced necroptosis and an exaggerated immune response in the lungs of infected Mmp‐8 −/− mice. Infected Mmp‐8 −/− mice had increased airway epithelial necroptosis with higher pulmonary levels of Type I interferons (IFNs), and increased frequencies of Class II MHC molecule‐expressing macrophages and CD4 + and CD8 + T cells, and higher levels of some Th1 cytokines. In vitro, MMP‐8 cleaved IL‐1β and IL‐6, but not Type I IFNs. These findings suggest that Mmp‐8 deficiency is associated with restricted influenza virus spread and increased lung injury, accompanied by enhanced Type I IFN‐associated necroptotic signaling and augmented antiviral immune responses. The latter may partly involve loss of MMP‐8‐mediated processing of pro‐inflammatory mediators. MMP‐8 may represent a host‐response target in severe influenza infection, although therapeutic strategies targeting MMP‐8 will need to balance enhanced viral clearance against the risk of increased lung immunopathology.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of Matrix Metalloproteinase-8 (MMP-8) in the pathogenesis of influenza A viral (IAV) disease, as its contributions to inflammatory responses and viral infection outcomes were previously unknown.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved H1N1-infected wild-type (WT) mice and Mmp-8 −/− mice, comparing their outcomes in terms of mortality, viral burden, and lung injury. Plasma MMP-8 levels were also assessed in subjects infected with H1N1 or seasonal IAV.
analysis.methods: MMP-8 levels were measured in the lungs and plasma of infected mice, and gene expression profiling was used to analyze immune responses. In vitro experiments were conducted to assess MMP-8's ability to cleave specific cytokines.
analysis.main_results: H1N1-infected Mmp-8 −/− mice showed lower mortality and reduced lung viral burdens but developed more severe lung injury compared to WT mice. Plasma MMP-8 levels were increased 30-fold in subjects infected with H1N1 or seasonal IAV and were inversely associated with the PaO2/FiO2 ratio.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that MMP-8 deficiency may lead to restricted viral spread but increased lung immunopathology, highlighting a potential host-response target for therapeutic strategies in severe influenza infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of targeted therapies that modulate host responses to balance viral clearance and immunopathology in severe influenza cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to animal models and in vitro experiments, which may not fully translate to human outcomes. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a single study with no direct human clinical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of Matrix Metalloproteinase-8 (MMP-8) in influenza A viral (IAV) disease, focusing on its impact on viral clearance and immunopathology. Using H1N1-infected wild-type (WT) and Mmp-8 −/− mice, the research found that MMP-8 deficiency reduced mortality and viral burden but increased lung injury. Plasma MMP-8 levels were elevated in IAV-infected subjects and inversely correlated with lung injury severity. In vitro experiments showed MMP-8 cleaves IL-1β and IL-6 but not Type I interferons. The study suggests MMP-8 could be a host-response target for therapies in severe influenza, though further human studies are needed. The evidence is moderate due to reliance on animal models and limited direct human data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨基质金属蛋白酶-8(MMP-8)在流感病毒A(IAV)疾病发病机制中的作用,因为其在炎症反应和病毒感染结果中的贡献此前尚不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及H1N1感染的野生型(WT)小鼠和Mmp-8 −/−小鼠,比较它们在死亡率、病毒载量和肺损伤方面的结果。同时,还评估了感染H1N1或季节性IAV的受试者血浆中MMP-8的水平。
elements_zh.methods: 测量了感染小鼠肺部和血浆中的MMP-8水平,并利用基因表达分析来研究免疫应答。进行了体外实验以评估MMP-8对特定细胞因子的切割能力。
elements_zh.main_results: H1N1感染的Mmp-8 −/−小鼠表现出较低的死亡率和较低的肺病毒载量,但与WT小鼠相比,肺损伤更为严重。感染H1N1或季节性IAV的受试者血浆中MMP-8水平升高了30倍,并且与PaO2/FiO2比值呈反向关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,MMP-8缺乏可能导致病毒传播受限但肺部免疫病理增加,突显了其作为宿主反应靶点的潜力,为严重流感感染的治疗策略提供了新的思路。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能有助于开发针对宿主反应的靶向疗法,以在严重流感病例中平衡病毒清除与免疫病理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于动物模型和体外实验,可能无法完全反映人类结果。证据强度中等,因为它基于单一研究,没有直接的人类临床数据。

title: Influenza vaccine effectiveness against hospitalization in children aged 6–72 months: a test-negative study in the Southern Italy, 2022–2026
abstract: BACKGROUND: Seasonal influenza is an important cause of hospitalization in young children, yet real-world evidence on vaccine effectiveness (VE) against severe outcomes remains limited in Italy. We estimated influenza VE against influenza-associated hospitalization among children aged 6-72 months in the district of Foggia, Southern Italy. METHODS: We conducted a test-negative case-control study among children hospitalized for acute respiratory infection and tested for influenza during the 2022-2023 to 2025-2026 influenza seasons. Cases were influenza-positive children and controls were influenza-negative children. VE was estimated as (1 - odds ratio) x 100; adjusted VE was derived from multivariable logistic regression models. RESULTS: The study included 935 children, of whom 207 were influenza-positive cases and 728 were influenza-negative controls. Adjusted VE was 62.5% (95% CI: 34.4%-78.5%) for receipt of at least one influenza vaccine dose and 61.9% (95% CI: 29.3%-79.4%) for full vaccination. By vaccine type, adjusted VE was 80.3% (95% CI: 43.8%-93.1%) for at least one dose of LAIV and 50.9% (95% CI: 6.9%-74.2%) for at least one dose of IIV. Season-specific adjusted VE was highest in 2024-2025, reaching 92.2% (95% CI: 65.6%-98.2%) for at least one dose and 90.7% (95% CI: 58.5%-97.9%) for full vaccination. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of influenza-associated hospitalization among children aged 6-72 months, with the strongest protection observed during the 2024-2025 season. These findings support continued efforts to improve pediatric influenza vaccination uptake.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND Seasonal influenza is an important cause of hospitalization in young children, yet real-world evidence on vaccine effectiveness (VE) against severe outcomes remains limited in Italy. We estimated influenza VE against influenza-associated hospitalization among children aged 6-72 months in the district of Foggia, Southern Italy. METHODS We conducted a test-negative case-control study among children hospitalized for acute respiratory infection and tested for influenza during the 2022-2023 to 2025-2026 influenza seasons. Cases were influenza-positive children and controls were influenza-negative children. VE was estimated as (1 - odds ratio) x 100; adjusted VE was derived from multivariable logistic regression models. RESULTS The study included 935 children, of whom 207 were influenza-positive cases and 728 were influenza-negative controls. Adjusted VE was 62.5% (95% CI: 34.4%-78.5%) for receipt of at least one influenza vaccine dose and 61.9% (95% CI: 29.3%-79.4%) for full vaccination. By vaccine type, adjusted VE was 80.3% (95% CI: 43.8%-93.1%) for at least one dose of LAIV and 50.9% (95% CI: 6.9%-74.2%) for at least one dose of IIV. Season-specific adjusted VE was highest in 2024-2025, reaching 92.2% (95% CI: 65.6%-98.2%) for at least one dose and 90.7% (95% CI: 58.5%-97.9%) for full vaccination. CONCLUSIONS Influenza vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of influenza-associated hospitalization among children aged 6-72 months, with the strongest protection observed during the 2024-2025 season. These findings support continued efforts to improve pediatric influenza vaccination uptake.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of influenza vaccines against hospitalization due to influenza in children aged 6–72 months in Southern Italy. A test-negative case-control study was conducted during the 2022–2023 to 2025–2026 influenza seasons, comparing influenza-positive and -negative children. The results showed that adjusted vaccine effectiveness (VE) was 62.5% for at least one dose and 61.9% for full vaccination. By vaccine type, VE was 80.3% for live attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) and 50.9% for inactivated influenza vaccine (IIV). Season-specific VE was highest in 2024–2025, reaching 92.2% for at least one dose and 90.7% for full vaccination. The findings suggest that influenza vaccination reduces the risk of hospitalization in children, with stronger protection observed during certain seasons. These results support efforts to increase vaccination rates in this population. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study design and the absence of reported limitations.

title: Economic analysis of adjuvanted trivalent influenza vaccine for older adults in the Korean National Immunization Program
abstract: Background Seasonal influenza causes substantial morbidity and mortality among older adults in South Korea despite high vaccination coverage. The MF59-adjuvanted trivalent influenza vaccine (aTIV) has shown superior immunogenicity in older populations, but its economic value within the Korean National Immunization Program (NIP) has not been evaluated using a dynamic transmission model that captures indirect protection. This study evaluated the budget impact of introducing aTIV into the Korean NIP for adults aged ≥65 years. Methods We developed an age-structured dynamic compartmental model to simulate seasonal influenza transmission in South Korea, allowing estimation of both direct and indirect protection effects. From the healthcare payer perspective and over a single influenza season, we performed a budget impact analysis complemented by a cost–benefit comparison of avoided medical costs against incremental vaccination expenditures. Two aTIV strategies were compared against standard quadrivalent influenza vaccine (QIV) within the NIP framework: Strategy I (aTIV for adults aged ≥75 years) and Strategy II (aTIV for all adults aged ≥65 years). Deterministic one-way sensitivity analyses examined relative vaccine effectiveness (rVE) of aTIV versus QIV across 5–30% and seasonal attack rate across ±20% of the 8.0% baseline, and a break-even analysis identified the rVE threshold at which incremental costs equal avoided treatment costs. A probabilistic sensitivity analysis was also conducted to quantify joint parameter uncertainty. Results At baseline (rVE 25%, attack rate 8.0%), Strategy I required $24.6 million in additional vaccine investment, with 52% offset by treatment savings, yielding a net budget impact of $11.7 million (+0.9% of total influenza-related healthcare expenditure). Strategy II required $54.4 million in additional costs with 57% offset ($31.2 million in savings), resulting in a net impact of $23.2 million (+1.8%). Strategy II prevented 535 deaths and over 15,000 hospitalizations—2.2-fold greater than Strategy I. The incremental cost of aTIV decreased with increasing transmission intensity, approaching cost neutrality during severe epidemic seasons. The break-even rVE at which aTIV becomes cost-saving was 44%, above central meta-analytic estimates (10–25%) but potentially attainable in severe seasons or specific subpopulations. Conclusion Introduction of aTIV into the Korean NIP is budget-feasible with substantial health benefits, requiring only a 0.9–1.8% increase in total influenza-related healthcare expenditure. At current rVE estimates (≤30%), aTIV does not achieve cost savings, but the additional fiscal burden remains modest. Strategy II offers superior health outcome value and is preferred when budget permits, while Strategy I provides a fiscally conservative entry point. The value proposition of aTIV is most favorable during severe influenza seasons.

title_zh: 韩国国家免疫接种计划中佐剂三价流感疫苗疫苗对老年人的经济分析
source_body_en: Background Seasonal influenza causes substantial morbidity and mortality among older adults in South Korea despite high vaccination coverage. The MF59-adjuvanted trivalent influenza vaccine (aTIV) has shown superior immunogenicity in older populations, but its economic value within the Korean National Immunization Program (NIP) has not been evaluated using a dynamic transmission model that captures indirect protection. This study evaluated the budget impact of introducing aTIV into the Korean NIP for adults aged ≥65 years. Methods We developed an age-structured dynamic compartmental model to simulate seasonal influenza transmission in South Korea, allowing estimation of both direct and indirect protection effects. From the healthcare payer perspective and over a single influenza season, we performed a budget impact analysis complemented by a cost–benefit comparison of avoided medical costs against incremental vaccination expenditures. Two aTIV strategies were compared against standard quadrivalent influenza vaccine (QIV) within the NIP framework: Strategy I (aTIV for adults aged ≥75 years) and Strategy II (aTIV for all adults aged ≥65 years). Deterministic one-way sensitivity analyses examined relative vaccine effectiveness (rVE) of aTIV versus QIV across 5–30% and seasonal attack rate across ±20% of the 8.0% baseline, and a break-even analysis identified the rVE threshold at which incremental costs equal avoided treatment costs. A probabilistic sensitivity analysis was also conducted to quantify joint parameter uncertainty. Results At baseline (rVE 25%, attack rate 8.0%), Strategy I required $24.6 million in additional vaccine investment, with 52% offset by treatment savings, yielding a net budget impact of $11.7 million (+0.9% of total influenza-related healthcare expenditure). Strategy II required $54.4 million in additional costs with 57% offset ($31.2 million in savings), resulting in a net impact of $23.2 million (+1.8%). Strategy II prevented 535 deaths and over 15,000 hospitalizations—2.2-fold greater than Strategy I. The incremental cost of aTIV decreased with increasing transmission intensity, approaching cost neutrality during severe epidemic seasons. The break-even rVE at which aTIV becomes cost-saving was 44%, above central meta-analytic estimates (10–25%) but potentially attainable in severe seasons or specific subpopulations. Conclusion Introduction of aTIV into the Korean NIP is budget-feasible with substantial health benefits, requiring only a 0.9–1.8% increase in total influenza-related healthcare expenditure. At current rVE estimates (≤30%), aTIV does not achieve cost savings, but the additional fiscal burden remains modest. Strategy II offers superior health outcome value and is preferred when budget permits, while Strategy I provides a fiscally conservative entry point. The value proposition of aTIV is most favorable during severe influenza seasons.

title: Molecular evolution and epitope landscape of influenza A(H1N1) viruses in Iran: insights from whole-genome sequencing (2023–2025)
abstract: Influenza viruses continuously evolve, resulting in genetic diversity that contributes to influenza epidemics and pandemics. This high mutation rate increases the probability of immune evasion, thereby reducing vaccine effectiveness. This study aimed to investigate the genomic and molecular changes in influenza A/H1N1 viruses during 2023–2025. In this study, whole-genome sequencing (WGS) of 30 influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 strains circulating in Iran during the 2023–2024 and 2024–2025 seasons was performed using Oxford Nanopore Technology. Subsequently, genomic, molecular, and phylogenetic analyses were performed, and vaccine efficacy was estimated using the epitope method. Whole-genome sequencing of influenza A/H1N1 viruses revealed that the strains circulating during the 2024–2025 season had a slightly lower similarity to the vaccine strain (98.78%) than those circulating during the 2023–2024 season (99.13%). Epitope A was the most diverse region during both seasons, with estimated vaccine efficacy against the dominant epitope ranging from 38.1% to 50.5% during 2023–2025. Several substitutions were identified in the internal proteins, of which the virulence-associated I123V substitution in NS1 was detected in both the vaccine and analyzed strains. Moreover, the studied strains remained largely susceptible to neuraminidase inhibitors, although one strain carried the S247N substitution. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that 90% of Iranian strains clustered within the 6B.1 A.5a.2a clade, which included globally circulating viruses from the same seasons. Despite topological differences among the phylogenetic trees, no reassortment was detected. The epitope landscape of Iranian A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses circulating during the 2023–2024 and 2024–2025 influenza seasons showed that their genetic makeup underwent seasonal changes due to antigenic drift in HA and NA. Despite these changes, the circulating strains remained closely related to the corresponding vaccine strain, and the estimated vaccine efficacy against the epitopes with the highest number of substitutions was acceptable, consistent with the WHO recommendation to retain A/Wisconsin/67/2022 for the 2025–2026 seasonal vaccine. This study emphasizes the importance of national influenza surveillance within global frameworks to monitor antigenic changes, assess pandemic risks, guide vaccine strain selection, and evaluate antiviral resistance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查2023–2025年间甲型H1N1流感病毒的基因组和分子变化。流感病毒不断进化,导致遗传多样性,从而促进流感疫情和大流行的产生。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023–2024和2024–2025季节在伊朗流行的30株流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒进行了全基因组测序(WGS)。该研究重点分析了季节性流感 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒及其分子进化。
elements_zh.methods: 全基因组基因组测序显示,2024–2025季节流行的病毒株与疫苗株(98.78%)的相似性略低于2023–2024季节流行的病毒株(99.13%)。进行了基因组、分子和系统发育分析,并利用表位方法估计了疫苗的效果。
elements_zh.main_results: 在内部蛋白中鉴定出数个取代变异,其中NS1中的与致病性相关的I123V取代变异在疫苗和分析的菌株中均被检测到。系统发育分析显示,90%的伊朗菌株聚类在6B.1 A.5a.2a分支中,该分支包括来自同一季节在全球范围内流行的病毒。伊朗甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒的表位景观表明,其遗传组成因抗原漂移在HA和NA中的作用而随季节发生变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒的季节性遗传变化及其对疫苗效力的影响。尽管存在这些变化,流行株仍与相应的疫苗株密切相关,且对突变数量最多的表位的估计疫苗效力是可以接受的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究强调了在全局框架内开展国家流感监测监测抗原变化、评估大流行风险、指导疫苗毒株选择以及评估抗病毒药物耐药性的重要性。研究结果提供了关于流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒分子进化及其对疫苗效果影响的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于有限数量病毒株的全基因组基因组测序,可能无法完全代表整个群体的遗传多样性。证据强度中等,因为其仅基于摘要数据,未包含详细的统计分析或长期随访。

abstract_zh: 流感病毒持续进化,导致遗传多样性,这有助于流感的流行和大流行。这种高进化速率增加了免疫逃逸的可能性,从而降低了疫苗有效性。本研究旨在调查2023–2025年间流感A/H1N1病毒的基因组和分子变化。本研究使用牛津纳米孔技术对伊朗2023–2024和2024–2025流感季节中流行的30株流感病毒进行了全基因组测序(WGS)。随后进行了基因组、分子和系统发育分析,并利用表位方法估计了疫苗有效性。流感A/H1N1病毒的全基因组测序显示,2024–2025流感季节流行的病毒株与疫苗株的相似性略低于2023–2024流感季节流行的病毒株(98.78% vs. 99.13%)。在两个流感季节中,表位A是最具多样性的区域,2023–2025年间针对主要表位的疫苗有效性估计为38.1%至50.5%。在内部蛋白中发现了几种取代,其中NS1蛋白与致病性相关的I123V取代在疫苗株和分析株中均被检测到。此外,所研究的病毒株总体上仍对神经氨酸酶抑制剂敏感,尽管有一株携带S247N取代。系统发育分析显示,90%的伊朗病毒株聚类在6B.1 A.5a.2a谱系中,该谱系包括了同一季节全球流行的病毒株。尽管系统发育树之间存在拓扑差异,但未检测到基因重配。伊朗2023–2024和2024–2025流感季节流行的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒的表位景观显示,其遗传组成因HA和NA中的突变而发生了季节性变化。尽管有这些变化,流行的病毒株仍与相应的疫苗株密切相关,针对突变最多的表位的疫苗有效性估计是可接受的,符合世界卫生组织保留A/Wisconsin/67/2022作为2025–2026季节性疫苗的建议。本研究强调了在国际框架下进行国家流感监测的重要性,以监测抗原变化、评估大流行风险、指导疫苗株选择以及评估抗病毒药物耐药性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查2023–2025年间甲型H1N1流感病毒的基因组和分子变化。流感病毒不断进化,导致遗传多样性,从而促进流感疫情和大流行的产生。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023–2024和2024–2025季节在伊朗流行的30株流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒进行了全基因组测序(WGS)。该研究重点分析了季节性流感 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒及其分子进化。
analysis_zh.methods: 全基因组基因组测序显示,2024–2025季节流行的病毒株与疫苗株(98.78%)的相似性略低于2023–2024季节流行的病毒株(99.13%)。进行了基因组、分子和系统发育分析,并利用表位方法估计了疫苗的效果。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在内部蛋白中鉴定出数个取代变异,其中NS1中的与致病性相关的I123V取代变异在疫苗和分析的菌株中均被检测到。系统发育分析显示,90%的伊朗菌株聚类在6B.1 A.5a.2a分支中,该分支包括来自同一季节在全球范围内流行的病毒。伊朗甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒的表位景观表明,其遗传组成因抗原漂移在HA和NA中的作用而随季节发生变化。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒的季节性遗传变化及其对疫苗效力的影响。尽管存在这些变化,流行株仍与相应的疫苗株密切相关,且对突变数量最多的表位的估计疫苗效力是可以接受的。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究强调了在全局框架内开展国家流感监测监测抗原变化、评估大流行风险、指导疫苗毒株选择以及评估抗病毒药物耐药性的重要性。研究结果提供了关于流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒分子进化及其对疫苗效果影响的见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于有限数量病毒株的全基因组基因组测序,可能无法完全代表整个群体的遗传多样性。证据强度中等,因为其仅基于摘要数据,未包含详细的统计分析或长期随访。

title: Influenza vaccine protection and contact patterns among outpatients with influenza-like illness during the 2024-2025 season in China: a test-negative case-control study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Continuous monitoring of both influenza vaccine protection and behavioural determinants of infection is important for understanding related risks. Evidence on influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) in China during the 2024-2025 season, however, remains limited. We aimed to assess influenza VE among healthcare-seeking outpatients with influenza-like illness (ILI) and to examine the contact patterns associated with infection risk. METHODS: We enrolled 928 outpatients with ILI from three sentinel hospitals in Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, China, between December 2024 and March 2025 in a test-negative case-control study. We confirmed influenza infection using reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction and collected vaccination history and social contact frequency and duration through questionnaires. We estimated VE using logistic regression with covariate adjustment, and otherwise analysed social contact patterns and performed exploratory sequencing of six randomly selected influenza-positive samples. RESULTS: Our full sample comprised 928 participants. We excluded 21 infants younger than 6 months from the VE analysis and included 907 participants, of whom 121 tested positive and 786 tested negative. The overall adjusted VE against medically attended influenza was 42.3% (95% credible interval = 11.1-62.5). In the analysis of social contacts for all 928 participants, test-positive children aged 0-10 years and adults aged 65 years or older reported more frequent and longer social contact than their test-negative counterparts. Exploratory sequencing of six samples suggested no major antigenic mismatch with the vaccine strains, but the very small number of sequenced samples limits the generalisability of this finding. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza vaccination provided moderate protection against medically attended influenza, while contact patterns were associated with infection risk among children and older adults. Combined vaccination and behavioural interventions warrant further evaluation, as the observational design of this study and its use of self-reporting data limit causal inference.

A test-negative case-control study was conducted at three sentinel hospitals in Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture, enrolling 928 participants. These results suggest the need for combined vaccination and behavioural interventions to reduce influenza transmission.

abstract_zh: 背景:持续监测流感疫苗保护效果和感染行为决定因素对于理解相关风险至关重要。然而,目前关于2024-2025流感季中国流感疫苗有效性(VE)的证据仍然有限。我们旨在评估流感疫苗在寻求医疗帮助的流感样病例(ILI)门诊患者中的有效性,并探讨与感染风险相关的接触模式。方法:我们在2024年12月至2025年3月期间,从中国伊犁哈萨克自治州的三家哨点医院招募了928名流感样病例门诊患者,进行一项测试阴性病例对照研究。我们通过逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)确认流感感染,并通过问卷收集疫苗接种接种史、社会接触频率和持续时间。我们使用带有协变量调整的逻辑回归模型来估计VE,并对社会接触模式进行分析,同时对六份随机选取的流感阳性样本进行探索性测序。结果:我们的完整样本包括928名参与者。在VE分析中,我们排除了21名小于6个月的婴儿,最终纳入907名参与者,其中121人检测为阳性,786人检测为阴性。针对医疗就诊流感的调整后总体VE为42.3%(95%可信区间=11.1-62.5)。在对所有928名参与者的社会接触分析中,检测为阳性的0-10岁儿童和65岁及以上成年人报告的社会接触频率和持续时间均高于检测为阴性的对应人群。六份样本的探索性测序表明,与疫苗毒株之间没有显著的抗原差异,但测序样本数量非常有限,限制了这一发现的普遍适用性。结论:流感疫苗接种对医疗就诊流感提供了中等程度的保护,而接触模式与儿童和老年人的感染风险相关。结合疫苗接种和行为干预措施需要进一步评估,因为本研究的观察性设计及其使用自我报告数据限制了因果推论的得出。科学与公共卫生意义:结合疫苗接种和行为干预措施需要进一步评估,因为本研究的观察性设计及其使用自我报告数据限制了因果推论的得出。局限性与证据强度:六份样本的探索性测序表明,与疫苗毒株之间没有显著的抗原差异,但测序样本数量非常有限,限制了这一发现的普遍适用性。研究的观察性设计及其使用自我报告数据限制了因果推论的得出。

title: Multiple introductions and spread of novel reassortant highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses via wild birds, South Korea, 2024–2025
abstract: Between 14 October 2024 and 24 March 2025, 43 cases of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) type A (H5N1) infections in wild birds and 1 case in a leopard cat were detected through the national HPAI surveillance program. We performed whole-genome sequencing of 51 isolates and investigated their phylogenetic relationships. Phylogenetic analyses identified nine distinct genotypes, designated Kor24-25A to Kor24-25I. The most commonly detected genotype, Kor24-25A (n = 24), was frequently detected in Pelecaniformes and was most prevalent between December 2024 and January 2025. title: Trends in long COVID and post-viral fatigue in children in primary care in England
abstract: BACKGROUND: Post-viral sequelae following the COVID-19 pandemic attention to post-viral fatigue and long COVID, but the impact on children and young people's (CYP) primary care use is unknown. AIM: To examine temporal, seasonal, and sociodemographic patterns in primary care consultations for long COVID and PVFS in CYP DESIGN AND SETTINGS: We conducted a retrospective, population-based dynamic cohort study using Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum data for CYP aged <18 years in England, between 1st January 2006 and 31st December 2022 (from 1st March 2020 for long COVID); a period covering the influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and COVID-19 pandemics. METHOD: Consultation rates per 100 000 child-years were calculated for long COVID and post-viral fatigue syndrome (PVFS) by calendar year, month, and sociodemographic characteristics. Trends, seasonal patterns, and differences between pandemic and non-pandemic periods (for PVFS) were described. Negative binomial regression was used to estimate associations with sociodemographic characteristics. RESULTS: The cohort included 7,442,572 CYP (3 624 692 registered in primary care during the COVID-19 pandemic). There were 6700 long COVID and 20,440 PVFS consultations. Long COVID consultation rates were highest in 2022 (140.3 per 100,00 child-years). PVFS consultation rates peaked in 2009 and 2022 (during H1N1 and COVID pandemics) with rates of 57.1 and 56.9 per 100 000 child-years, respectively. Consultation rates were highest among older CYP, girls, and those from least deprived areas. CONCLUSION: Long COVID consultations were highest in 2022, and PVFS consultation rates peaked during 2009 and 2022. Our findings that rates were highest in less deprived areas and girls need further investigation.
